text:
jess: Quick thread — need final call on Optimize toolkit launch slice for eval-triggered alerts + recs. Customers pushing for early pilot (AcmeHealth). Proposed minimal launch: eval alerts (precision/regression), batch/cache recommendations (opt-in), quantization guidance (read-only). Gate: alert precision drop > 3% on median prompts over 24h OR false-positive rate < 5% in pilot. Thoughts? :thinking:

mike: Can we make that gate metric concrete? how's "median prompt" defined? also worry about noise at small traffic levels.

anya: +1 on concern. For pilots, use rolling window of 72h or require >=500 evals before triggering.

sam: I like 500 evals. Also, recommend a canary -> 10% of tenants then 100% if stable for 7d. :thumbsup:

luis: For batching/cache recs, need telemetry: per-route seq length histogram. Otherwise suggestions will be wrong. Can we require telemetry signal as launch dependency?

jess: Yes, telemetry dependency noted. Proposal: require per-route seq hist >= 1k samples, latency impact estimate available. If not available, show 'data insufficient' state in UI.

mike: Alerts rule syntax proposal:
```
alert if precision_drop >= 0.03 AND eval_count >= 500 AND window_hours >= 72
```
This should be in docs and in UI builder.

anya: UX: allow customers to mute noisy prompts and surface top 10 failing prompts. Announce that in rollout notes.

sam: Rollout ops: must include fail-open fallback to baseline model and automatic rollback policy for 5% error spike.

jess: Ack. So action items: (1) Docs with rule examples (mike), (2) telemetry gating + UI 'insufficient data' state (luis), (3) canary + rollback policies (sam), (4) small wording on pilot comms to AcmeHealth (anya). I'll shepherd. Timeline: aim for alpha pilot w/c 2026-02-09. Any blockers?

luis: Need infra ticket for per-route hist. I'll open it today.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature-telemetry-metrics -> staging at 1769015000

mike: one last ask — add a "quiet hours" option so alerts don't fire for scheduled model updates.

jess: Good catch. Adding to scope. Thanks everyone. I'll sync with Eng PM tomorrow 10am PST.
